claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Valdecoxib is a COX-2-selective NSAID with arylsulfonamide-mediated nanomolar carbonic anhydrase inhibition, but at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to produce little or no direct cytotoxicity in cancer cell lines.
